headline: President Obama signed an order creating a Presidential Commission on Election Administration.
what_it_does: This executive order sets up a new presidential commission focused on how elections are run. The title does not describe the commission's members, specific tasks, or powers. Based on the title alone, it appears to be an advisory group rather than a new set of rules.

who_it_affects.how: The title suggests the commission focuses on election administration, the work these officials do, but no details on its effect on them are given.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely upon signing on March 28, 2013 (not stated in the material provided)
